The witness report does not confirm the brake type and lists brake condition as not shown.

risks.risk: Drivetrain components (chain and sprockets) may be rusted or excessively worn.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the chain, rear cassette, and front chainrings.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full drivetrain replacement.

risks.risk: Suspension components may be seized or non-functional.
risks.proof: Video showing the front and rear suspension compressing and rebounding under weight.
risks.if_unproven: as a rigid frame with non-functional suspension.

risks.risk: Braking system may be ineffective or require replacement parts.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the brake calipers/pads and a video of the brakes stopping the wheels.

risks.risk: Tires and inner tubes may be perished or punctured.
risks.proof: Video of the tires being squeezed to show air pressure or the bike being ridden.
risks.if_unproven: as needing new tires and tubes.

risks.risk: Structural damage or heavy rust on the non-visible side of the frame.
risks.proof: Photos of the opposite side of the entire bicycle.
risks.if_unproven: as having significant cosmetic and minor structural wear.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the brakes to confirm if they are disc or rim brakes.
Clear photo of the chain and rear gears to check for rust.
Photo of the left side of the bike.
Short video of the gears shifting and the suspension moving.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the brand and model as a Shockwave Dirt 24, which allows for a baseline valuation at its worst-case functional condition.
